verdict.rationale: Seer is documented as scanning incoming issues automatically to find root causes and automate triage (sentry-docs-5, sentry-docs-34), and the Seer Agent answers questions about application telemetry (sentry-docs-31). Together these give responders AI-generated diagnostic context. However, no evidence shows an explicit AI summary of an incident, or AI-generated context attached to alerts and notifications such as Slack messages, which only cover plain new-issue alerts. missing for 10: explicit AI-generated incident/issue summaries, AI context embedded in alert notifications for responders, independent or hands-on corroboration of Seer's output quality.
